test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 11 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

I’ll see you __in the meets__ next week.
solution:
The correct answer is "**at the meeting.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct preposition to use in this context is 'at', which means physically present in a meeting or event.
 
 
• Example: I will meet you at the coffee shop.
 
 
 
• 'In' is used to refer to being inside a physical space or container, which doesn't fit the context of the sentence.
 
 
• Example: We went for a swim in the lake.
 
 
 
• **If we are required to refer to the meeting as a location, we use “at a/the meeting.” **
 
• **If we mean to refer to the meeting as an activity without specifying location we use “in a/the meeting.”**
 
• **In the given sentence, the meeting is referred to as a location.**
 
• **Thus, the correct preposition to use will be "at."**

**​**Hence, **the correct answer is option 1.**
